_comment: Full-state digests (Simulation.state_digest) for simulation contract 1. Keys are '<sys.platform>-<machine>' because trajectories differ across platforms (confirmed: linux-x86_64 and win32-amd64 diverge for the same seed; each is stable across Python 3.11-3.13). A missing key skips the test; record one with `python tests/record_golden.py`. Changing an existing value is a simulation-contract change and must be explained in CHANGELOG.md.
